name: IndiaCos MCP
summary: MCP and API over Indian company, LLP, GST, IP and MSME records from public government sources, with free starter credit then prepaid calls.
description: Remote Streamable HTTP MCP at https://indiacos.com/mcp. Sign in with OAuth (email code) or send Authorization: Bearer <key>. Tools include search, find, get_company, get_company_directors, get_gst, get_pan, get_director, get_cases, trademark/patent/design/copyright search and get, search_msme, search_defaulters, get_wallet and top_up_wallet. Web pages are free to read and cite; API/MCP need an account (₹50 free credit on signup, then ₹0.40 per successful call from a prepaid wallet). Reuse is under the IndiaCos Data Licence. llms.txt and auth.md cover agent signup.

agent_access.notes: OAuth or Bearer API key. Protected-resource metadata at indiacos.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp. Agent signup: /auth.md.
